name: bootstrap-orchestrate
description: The /orchestrate skill: delegate one task to a sub-agent of the model and effort you name, in one continuous thread. Also sets the effort and lifetime of every sub-agent spawn.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate one task to a sub-agent you choose
interface.longDescription: Name a model and an effort level, and one retained sub-agent implements, tests and repairs in a continuous thread while you coordinate and verify evidence. Independent review stays separate. Loads whenever an agent delegates, to set each spawn's effort and lifetime; it never asks an agent to delegate.
defaultPrompt: Use an opus sub-agent with high effort for this task.
Delegate this to one retained sub-agent to build, test and repair; verify its evidence.
